attestations.text: HSÜ Kuang-ch'i 徐光啟 (T. 子先, H. 玄扈), Apr. 24, 1562–1633, Nov. 8, scholar and official, was a native of Shanghai. He became a hsiu-ts'ai in 1581, but failed several times in the provincial examinations.
